description:
Configure global customer settings for a B2B 'Pro' portal launch. You need to update the Customer Configuration to collect more data and enforce stricter security.

Navigate to Stores > Configuration > Customers > Customer Configuration.

1. Under 'Name and Address Options':
   - Set 'Number of Lines in a Street Address' to 3.
   - Set 'Show Tax/VAT Number' to Required.
   - Set 'Show Date of Birth' to Required.

2. Under 'Create New Account Options':
   - Set 'Email Sender' to 'Customer Support'.

3. Under 'Password Options':
   - Set 'Minimum Password Length' to 10.
   - Set 'Number of Required Character Classes' to 4.

Save the configuration. If you are not logged in, use credentials: admin / Admin1234!
